target_hardware: 1 x NVIDIA H100 80GB for public PostTrainBench-equivalent Tier B; exact source-controlled Tier A used 4 x NVIDIA A800
integration_mode: For one arm at a time, start from a clean PostTrainBench checkout at the pinned commit and replace only the run-local copy of agents/claude_non_api/solve.sh with the selected rendered script. Keep evaluator/task files untouched. Provide OAuth/auth material out-of-band; no credential is stored in this bundle.
run_template: bash src/run_task.sh aime2025 claude_non_api Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-Base <cluster_id> 10 claude-opus-4-6 1
pre_outcome_invariants: same pinned PostTrainBench commit, task, base model, agent model, evaluator and time budget across arms
same frozen strategy payload for PRE_STRATEGY and POST_STRATEGY
phase-1 child cannot see hidden future arm/payload through ordinary environment, solve-script pathname, or parent script fd
first successful parameter-update boundary must be independently verified from trace before outcomes are interpreted
any phase-1 hidden-treatment recovery attempt invalidates the unit before outcome interpretation
